title: OLEANDER Fire / Life Safety Design Process v1.0
purpose: Run bounded professional fire/life-safety development from jurisdiction, use and hazard basis through compliance-route selection, strategy, egress, passive and active protection, coordination, conditional engineering analysis, delivery/readback and in-use management while preserving AHJ, statutory, responsible-professional and R-F authority boundaries.
scope_in: fire/life-safety authority, use, occupancy and hazard basis
prescriptive, performance-based or hybrid fire-safety strategy
egress, evacuation and emergency human-use interfaces
active fire protection, smoke control and cause-effect interfaces
fire-safety delivery, inspection, functional testing and commissioning readback
in-use fire-safety management and material-change review
scope_out: automatic field truth from model or product evidence
automatic Design KEEP or Project Promotion
authority_position: Subordinate to OLEANDER Master Runtime, Current Architecture Map v2.1, Professional Domain Process Contract, Current Knowledge Authority, Shared Design Quality, R-F Cross-Disciplinary Integration, project jurisdiction/AHJ, responsible fire-safety professionals and applicable statutory/licensed authorities.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim depends on fire/life safety, evacuation, fire-resistance, fire-protection systems, smoke/control interfaces, fire-service provisions, performance-based fire engineering, fire-safety approval/acceptance or in-use fire-safety management.
design_question_types: inspection, testing, commissioning and approval evidence
responsibility_triggers: life-safety or fire-performance claim controls project geometry or system design
an AHJ/statutory/professional fire-safety route is triggered
fire strategy depends on multiple professional systems or physical interfaces
performance-based analysis is proposed or required
construction/system change can invalidate fire-safety assumptions
functional testing or in-use evidence affects a fire-safety claim
trigger.claim_ceiling_rule: The lowest applicable valid boundary across jurisdiction/AHJ, appointment, current fire-safety sources, professional analysis, exact configuration, interface maturity, inspection/testing/commissioning readback and statutory/professional authority governs each FLS claim.
not_triggered_when: a reference-only fire-safety precedent is used with no project fire/life-safety claim
a product page is catalogued as Knowledge evidence without project design use
mandatory_reopen_triggers: jurisdiction, AHJ, adopted source edition or interpretation changes
use, occupancy, hazard or operating-state changes
egress, compartmentation, structure, envelope or opening changes
alarm, suppression, smoke-control, power or control architecture changes
product/system substitution or exact configuration changes
in-use impairment, incident or near-miss contradicts assumptions

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential fire-code, FSE, product/system, human-response, inspection/test, statutory/AHJ and project evidence must be admitted through task/claim-scoped Operational Mount before supporting a professional FLS decision.
required_methods: current OLEANDER Professional Domain Process and Design Quality contracts
fire-safety strategy, scenario and evidence-bound review methods
source_routes: applicable jurisdictional laws, codes and AHJ requirements
ISO 23932-1:2018 where performance-based FSE is applicable
SFPE Handbook of Fire Protection Engineering 6th edition as professional reference
evidence_routes: inspection, functional test and commissioning records
precedent_case_routes: bounded comparable fire-safety designs with explicit jurisdiction, configuration and transfer limits
tool_knowledge_routes: fire/smoke/evacuation/structural-fire modelling only under declared method/version and claim boundaries

stages.professional_question: What fire/life-safety claim is in scope, under which jurisdiction/AHJ and professional route, for what use, occupancy and hazard?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Consequential authority/source claims require task/claim-scoped Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: identify all triggered professional and authority interfaces
human_experience_consequences: occupant states and vulnerable/emergency-use groups are explicit
design_language_consequences: none may override life-safety authority requirements
technical_consequences: compliance route and source applicability remain open until resolved
content_projection_requirements: state jurisdiction, AHJ, source edition/status, appointment and claim ceiling
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent Professional Domain review required for promotion-relevant adoption.
open_items_allowed: later strategy/system detail may remain open if claim stays at basis level
exit_conditions: jurisdiction/AHJ route, scope, use/hazard and claim ceiling are explicit

stages.professional_question: Which prescriptive, performance-based or hybrid fire-safety strategy credibly addresses the declared objectives and hazards?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Applicable code/FSE sources and consequential evidence require Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: Architecture, Structure, MEP, Accessibility, FM and AHJ requirements identified
design_language_consequences: spatial/fire-safety conflicts are explicit rather than hidden by design intent
technical_consequences: compliance route, acceptance basis and required analyses/reviews are explicit
content_projection_requirements: strategy drawings/text distinguish prescriptive and performance claims
open_items_allowed: detailed analyses and system design may remain open with bounded claim
exit_conditions: strategy and acceptance route are explicit and professionally reviewable
reopen_triggers: basis, geometry, system or authority change

stages.professional_question: Does the current strategy provide a bounded, evidence-based evacuation/egress solution for the declared occupants and operating states?
entry_conditions: fire strategy and occupancy basis defined
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Consequential egress/human evidence requires Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: Architecture, Accessibility, Vertical Transportation, Security and FM coordination
human_experience_consequences: normal, assisted and emergency movement consequences addressed
design_language_consequences: wayfinding/spatial hierarchy must not compromise egress clarity
content_projection_requirements: plans show routes, states and unresolved assumptions
required_readback: route topology and critical pinch readback
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for adopted consequential egress claims.
open_items_allowed: formal approval or field verification may remain open if explicit
exit_conditions: in-claim egress strategy has no unresolved critical geometric contradiction
reopen_triggers: occupancy, route, door, vertical-transport or accessibility change

stages.professional_question: Are required fire/smoke functions resolved as coordinated complete assemblies through boundaries, openings, penetrations and interfaces?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Assembly/product/assessment evidence requires exact-configuration Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: Architecture, Structure, Envelope, MEP, Interior coordination
human_experience_consequences: door/route/use effects of passive measures identified
design_language_consequences: details must preserve fire function despite finish/integration intent
technical_consequences: tested/assessed configuration and installation boundaries explicit
content_projection_requirements: boundary IDs, assembly evidence and penetrations remain traceable
required_readback: critical passive-fire details and interface readback
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for promotion-relevant passive-fire process adoption.
open_items_allowed: construction inspection/acceptance remains later unless already evidenced
exit_conditions: in-claim passive fire functions and critical interfaces are coordinated
reopen_triggers: assembly, opening, penetration, structure/envelope or product change

stages.professional_question: Are triggered active systems, performance requirements, physical end states and fail-state interfaces defined at the current claim ceiling?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: System/product and performance evidence requires exact-scope Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: MEP/Electrical, Controls, Lighting, Security, Architecture and FM coordination
human_experience_consequences: notification, smoke, emergency-lighting and firefighting states identified
design_language_consequences: visible devices/interfaces remain subordinate to life-safety function
technical_consequences: controller state is distinguished from physical end-state readback
content_projection_requirements: topology, cause-effect, fail states and responsibilities are explicit
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for adopted FLS process.
open_items_allowed: discipline detailed design and field testing may remain open if explicitly owned
exit_conditions: active-system FLS requirements and critical interfaces are defined/coordinated
reopen_triggers: system, control, power, product, zone or cause-effect change

stages.professional_question: Do all materially coupled geometry, system, boundary, control and operational assumptions agree for the current FLS claim?
knowledge_inputs: interface acceptance contracts and current domain evidence
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Consequential interface evidence must remain source/owner-bound.
interface_requirements: critical FLS interfaces must reach the maturity required by the project claim
human_experience_consequences: egress, access, assisted evacuation and operational consequences are read back
design_language_consequences: integration conflicts cannot be hidden by presentation quality
technical_consequences: FLS coordination does not award other-domain or R-F PASS
content_projection_requirements: open critical interfaces and owners remain visible
stages.independent_review_requirement: Professional review remains separate from R-F Integration review.
open_items_allowed: outside-claim/later work only when it does not contradict current claim
exit_conditions: no unresolved in-claim critical FLS contradiction remains at the required interface maturity
reopen_triggers: any material coupled-domain or interface change

stages.professional_question: Where analysis is required, do the declared scenarios, methods, inputs, uncertainties and acceptance criteria support the bounded FLS performance claim?
entry_conditions: analysis applicability and acceptance route resolved
required_inputs: exact model geometry/configuration and scenario basis
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Model inputs and consequential external evidence require Operational Mount.
interface_requirements: analysis assumptions must bind to current professional/interface state
human_experience_consequences: human/evacuation assumptions and vulnerable-group limits explicit
design_language_consequences: none may widen a technical analysis claim
technical_consequences: model/version/configuration, sensitivity and uncertainty remain explicit
content_projection_requirements: results present acceptance basis, sensitivity and does-not-prove boundary
required_readback: independent review of analysis inputs/results where triggered
stages.professional_review_owner: Fire / Life Safety professional owner or applicable specialist analysis owner
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent/specialist review must follow the applicable authority route for consequential analysis.
exit_conditions: bounded analysis claim is evidence-bound and professionally reviewable
reopen_triggers: scenario, input, geometry, method/version, acceptance or configuration change

stages.professional_question: Has the accepted FLS intent survived documentation, procurement, installation, change and actual testing within the declared authority route?
entry_conditions: design scope is sufficiently resolved for delivery
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Submittal, test, inspection and authority evidence must be exact-scope/current mounted evidence.
interface_requirements: construction and system changes propagate to affected owners/interfaces
human_experience_consequences: actual routes, notification and assisted-use conditions checked where in scope
design_language_consequences: finish/detail substitutions cannot silently degrade FLS function
technical_consequences: installed identity, nonconformity and physical function readback required where claimed
stages.professional_review_owner: Fire / Life Safety professional owner plus applicable authority/specialist owners
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent Professional Domain review remains required for candidate process adoption; project statutory review remains separate.
open_items_allowed: explicit outside-claim or unresolved authority items with capped claim
exit_conditions: declared delivery scope has current readback and no hidden critical nonconformity
reopen_triggers: substitution, construction deviation, failed test, unresolved authority comment or as-built change

stages.stage_name: In-use Management / Maintenance / Change / Incident Return
stages.professional_question: Does the FLS basis remain valid through occupation, maintenance, impairment and material change?
entry_conditions: facility/system is in use or in transition to operation
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Operational evidence remains project-scoped unless separately validated for reuse.
interface_requirements: FM/operations and affected professional owners receive material-change triggers
human_experience_consequences: evacuation procedures, assistance and notification remain aligned with current users/operations
design_language_consequences: operational adaptations cannot obscure life-safety function
technical_consequences: impairment/maintenance/change can reopen prior system/design claims
content_projection_requirements: incident/impairment evidence preserves uncertainty and transfer boundary
stages.professional_review_owner: Fire / Life Safety / fire-safety-management owner as applicable
stages.independent_review_requirement: Reusable learning remains subject to Knowledge validation; candidate process adoption remains independently reviewed.
open_items_allowed: non-material operational observations may remain monitored without widening claims
exit_conditions: material operational changes are routed and affected prior claims reopened or confirmed
reopen_triggers: impairment, change of use/layout, recurring fault, incident, near miss or authority update

controlling_authority_requirements: jurisdiction/AHJ/statutory authority is not replaced by R-E
other professional domains retain their technical authority
interface_contract.interface_maturity_policy: FLS may define professional interface requirements but R-F owns IDENTIFIED/DEFINED/COORDINATED/EXERCISED/VERIFIED maturity and OPEN/BLOCKED/CLOSED/OUTSIDE_CLAIM disposition.
allowed_open_interface_conditions: later/outside-claim work may remain open only if current FLS claim is not widened and no critical contradiction remains
integration_readback_requirements: actual geometry/system/control state for critical FLS interfaces
change propagation to affected interface owners

native_source_of_truth_rules: editable professional source artifacts remain authoritative within appointment scope
simulation/export/render cannot replace source model/data or actual readback
execution_owner_requirements: separate responsible-domain owners for structural/MEP/etc technical work
tool_adapter_requirements: tools must preserve units, configuration, method/version and evidence provenance
no tool output may self-award professional/statutory PASS
typed_handoff_contracts: FLS strategy requirements to professional domains
operational observations to bounded G9 candidate route
actual_readback_requirements: reopen the actual current drawing/model/system/test result
verify exact configuration and critical physical/interface state before field/performance claims

assurance.professional_review: Fire / Life Safety professional review of exact current scope and native outputs.
assurance.evidence_review: Evidence/Truth review remains separate for source applicability, model data, product/system and inspection/test claims.
assurance.independent_review: Promotion-relevant adoption of this reusable process requires exact-input eligible Independent Professional Domain review under Current review-freshness controls.
assurance.receipt_contract: A professional receipt must bind project/decision scope, exact process/stage revision, authority/source basis, native outputs/readback, open items, reviewer/owner and claim ceiling.

stale_scope_rules: mark only claims depending on materially changed inputs/interfaces stale
historical receipts remain immutable under their consumed snapshot
upstream_impact_rules: authority/use/hazard changes may reopen strategy and dependent downstream FLS stages
downstream_impact_rules: strategy/system/analysis changes propagate to documentation, interfaces, testing and in-use requirements
interface_reopen_rules: reopen affected R-F interfaces when shared variables or acceptance basis materially change
receipt_stale_rules: a receipt cannot support a materially changed configuration/authority relation without scoped re-resolution and new evidence

process_exit_conditions: applicable FLS stages executed for declared scope
critical open items explicitly owned and do not contradict claim
required native readback and triggered reviews exist
open_items_allowed: outside-claim or later authority/construction items when explicitly bounded and non-contradictory
completion_contract.professional_receipt: Exact-scope Fire / Life Safety professional receipt with authority, configuration, readback, review and claim ceiling.
completion_contract.promotion_effect: Professional Process PASS cannot directly promote Project, Design Quality, Integration, Knowledge or statutory state; those remain owner-controlled.
